author: JustBudah
body:
I got told to make a forum report since I recorded the match between Ethernal Cross and Apollo.

ErikMC, I think that all the clips that I've put together are actually evidence of him hacking, personally I don't think that it's enough but any evidence can help. In the last clip you have to slow down the video to 0.25 and you see him hitting on legoche while legoche already died.
If you want a further explaination of the clips, tell me.

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ivg_DzSdUcM&feature=youtu.be

Adios,
Budah
